name: Banco ABC Brasil S.A.
summary: Banco ABC Brasil S.A., a commercial bank, provides various financial products and services to middle and large companies in Brazil. The company offers current account; loan and finance products, such as working capital, revolving, receivables, anticipation to suppliers, payroll-linked loan for employees, on lending in foreign currency, and foreign currency loans, as well as for agribusiness, foreign trade, transfers from the coffee economy defense fund, and real estate; guarantee issues, such as payment guarantee issued, performance guarantee issued, judicial guarantee issued, stand-by letter of credit, confirmation of export letters of credit, bid bond, performance bond, and import letter o…
